newsitem.title: USA: Sinter Metals files for 2.2 mln common shrs.
newsitem.headline: Sinter Metals files for 2.2 mln common shrs.

text.p: Sinter Metals Inc said Tuesday it filed a registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to 2.2 million Class A common shares.
Of the total, 1,760,000 Class A common are being offered in the United States and Canada and 440,000 Class A common shares elsewhere, the filing said.
After the offering, outstanding Class A common will total 7,209,747 shares and Class B will total 2,543,381 shares, the filing said.

The company has granted the underwriters a 30-day over-allotment option to purchase up 330,000 additional Class A common shares. The offering will be made through Morgan Stanley & Co Inc and Salomon Brothers.
Proceeds will be used to repay debt incurred under a new credit facility in connection with acquisitions, Sinter said.
Sinter, of Cleveland, Ohio, is an independent manufacturer of precision pressed powder metal parts.
